title: Discreet By Design
lessons: even the loyalty program keeps score

intro.speaker: ZYN
text: Deck's due at nine and it's just us and the janitor's vacuum. Cozy.
No smoke break needed, by the way. That's kind of the whole pitch.

choices.text: Fine. What's the discreet version of a coffee break?
I'm good. Coffee is enough vice for a Tuesday.
Odorless, invisible... discreet for whom, exactly?

branch-accept.speaker: ZYN
text: Tuck it top lip, keep typing. Nobody in that room will ever know.
That's the feature. No flame, no fog, no HR email.

branch-decline.speaker: ZYN
text: Respect. Caffeine and hydration — the classics.
I'll be here being invisible. It's mostly waiting.

branch-audit.speaker: ZYN
text: Sharp question for someone on their fifth revision tonight.
Discreet for the room. Convenient for me. Same pocket, honestly.

flow.speaker: ZYN
text: Watch: three-hour review call, zero smoke breaks, zero smell, zero clues.
You'll finish the deck and nobody will know how. That's the romance.

tension.speaker: ZYN
text: Honest hour: when something leaves no evidence, you stop counting it.
And the rewards app scans every can anyway. Points banked. Even the habit keeps score.

choices.text: Invisible comfort got me through Q3. I'll take the win.
'Stops counting' is doing a lot of load-bearing work in that sentence.

wrap.speaker: ZYN

text: You asked who discretion serves. Most people never do. Ferda, detective.
Answer was always 'both of us.' That's the uncomfortable part.
Desk drawer, left side. Your secret's safe.
Finish strong. I'll be under the desk, quietly.
Nine a.m. deadline. You've got the deck; I've got discretion.
